description: Facebook ads reward timing. Bring a strong product into an underserved market and scale before it’s crowded
transcript: Facebook is an option, right? Facebook will find the users and I think people grossly underestimate the element of competition in that bidding system of Facebook. I think as soon as there's a second or third competitor for that exact product, it grossly increases the CPM's and changes the business. This is where those niches really, really find those pockets that are just completely underserved and that's where you just get those crazy results initially. So focus on a product that does well in a different market, bring it to a market that doesn't have it and run it for as long as it's not overcrowded. Yeah, get the team in place, build the brand on the layer of that product. Make sure the product actually serves a certain function and build that brand around that function. For hoodie, it's comfort. Then add secondary products that are probably more evergreen. So this year I think we'll do 50 million through sleep teas, which is our night teas, our dressing gowns, our bath hoodies. So it's about riding that wave as much as you can, getting the cash, focusing on product and brand. We build a sustainable business through that.
